description: Source code for an EPUB document loader component in a software project, implementing the INode interface, handling EPUB file input, metadata processing, and document extraction using langchain and filesystem operations.

classes.name: Epub_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing EPUB file loading and processing, conforming to the INode interface, with methods for initialization and document extraction.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronous method to initialize the EPUB loader, process input files, extract documents, and return either document objects or concatenated text.

methods.name: extractDocs
methods.description: Private asynchronous method to load EPUB content using EPubLoader, split documents if a TextSplitter is provided, and append to the docs array.
